Release purpose
---------------
v0.21.2 preserves the v0.21.1 native zlib/DEFLATE arithmetic-precision repair
(`::options digits 30`) and repairs split package identity/provenance that left
Alchemy metadata and @@msqlshim_version at v0.20 while the compatibility snapshot
reported v0.21.1.  All public identity surfaces now agree on v0.21.2.

Execution note
--------------
The package's aggregate run_tests.sh was exercised as its constituent tests under
the same environment because the hosted execution wrapper imposes a wall-clock
limit shorter than the cumulative repeated-listener suite.  The protocol suite
through prepared statements passed in the aggregate run; the two long stress
regressions were then run separately at the run_tests.sh validation loads shown
above.  No constituent acceptance failed.
